tools.name: verify_launch_audit
tools.description: Recheck the native findings from a saved audit after changes are live. Preserve unavailable checks as unobservable. Requires original audit JSON for the same URL. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: audit_my_launch
tools.description: Audit a public URL across selected launch, technical, and agent-readiness checks. Return separate scores, evidence, fix packs, and matching resources. No account actions, provider generation, or publishing. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: search_launch_resources
tools.description: Find relevant public LaunchBuddy guides, free tools, skills, and relevant launch channels for a specific gap. Channel presence never proves eligibility, supported submission, or publication. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: get_launch_resource
tools.description: Read one public launch resource by its stable ID, including canonical URL and channel availability where applicable. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: assess_launch
tools.description: Assess a public launch URL and return the scored launch gaps plus a durable report URL. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: Read a saved public LaunchBuddy assessment by scan id. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: reassess_launch
tools.description: Reassess a connected project after changes and compare its score without creating a second project. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: claim_assessment
tools.description: Save an anonymous assessment to the connected account without scanning again or starting a trial. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the connected account's LaunchBuddy projects. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: create_growth_plan
tools.description: Create or read the free cached plan of ranked launch work for a connected project. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: get_launch_todos
tools.description: Read the connected project checklist and its completion progress. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: update_launch_todo
tools.description: Update one owned launch task without starting provider work. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: preview_recommended_asset
tools.description: Preview the highest-priority asset brief without starting provider spend. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: create_recommended_asset
tools.description: Prepare the highest-priority asset. Never charges or publishes; returns a resumable paid/approval handoff when required. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: get_action_intent
tools.description: Read the resumable payment, approval, render, and verification state after a web handoff. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.

tools.name: get_access
tools.description: Explain the current identity, trial, paid entitlement, and available capabilities. Documentation: https://launchbuddy.com/agents.
